Why Philippine Businesses Are Switching from Biometric Machines to Cloud GPS Time Clocks

How modern privacy regulations (Data Privacy Act (RA 10173), CCPA, ePrivacy) work and how to track 100% of website traffic without collecting personal data.

Maria Santos (Owner)Privacy Engineer

Cookie consent banners are universally despised by users and devastating for website conversion rates. Studies show that between 40% and 65% of visitors simply click "Decline" or leave the website entirely when confronted with a giant modal covering the viewport.

When visitors reject cookies, tools like Google Analytics are legally barred from tracking them. This leaves marketing and product teams with incomplete, skewed datasets.

Data Blindspots
If 50% of your visitors reject tracking cookies, your recorded tardiness rate, conversion rate, and acquisition sources are essentially statistical fiction.

How Cookieless Analytics Works#

Cookieless analytics replaces persistent client-side identifiers (cookies, localStorage, canvas fingerprints) with a daily rotating cryptographic hash.

Here is how the privacy-preserving hashing protocol works:

  1. When a visitor requests a page, ClockTime takes the IP Address and User-Agent string.
  2. A daily rotating cryptographic Salt is combined with the string.
  3. A non-reversible SHA-256 hash is generated to identify unique time clock punches within the same calendar day.
  4. The raw IP address is discarded immediately from volatile memory and is never written to disk.

Because the salt rotates automatically every 24 hours, it is mathematically impossible to track or re-identify a user across multiple days or across different websites.

Tracking Precision
99.4%+45% vs Google Analytics

Accurate traffic measurement achieved without storing a single byte on the client browser.

Data Privacy Act (RA 10173) and ePrivacy Directive Compliance#

According to the European Data Protection Board (EDPB) and EU Privacy Directive:

  • No Cookies: No files or data packets are stored or read from the user's terminal equipment.
  • No PII: No names, emails, static IP addresses, or cross-site fingerprints are recorded.
  • No Consent Banner Needed: Under Recital 30 and Article 5(3), consent banners are only required when storing or accessing non-essential data on client devices.
Zero Legal Overhead
ClockTime is 100% compliant with EU Data Privacy Act (RA 10173), California CCPA/CPRA, UK PECR, and Brazilian LGPD right out of the box.

Conclusion#

Privacy and powerful analytics are no longer mutually exclusive. By discarding intrusive cookies and embracing edge-based cryptographic hashes, you respect your visitors' privacy while regaining total visibility into your traffic and revenue.
